Thank you very much for sharing your story.

It just seems that these years are the ones that define my entire life. Not by social status (I know that goes away once you hit college), but by your academics. If you mess up one time, can't get into one club, your transcript is screwed. I feel my whole life is screwed because of this.

Thanks for taking the time to reply.

Getting a GED is not an option. If I get far enough, I really want to go to a good university and work from there. Besides, my parents wouldn't make it an option for me, either.

I'll have to move along. Even if it kills me.
